title: Add the preference to store a set of TLS Session Keys files used
description:
for TLS decryption. Unlike the (Pre)Master-Secret key file, these
ones aren't followed, they are considered static.

The use case is when you have been provided multiple traces with
many key files and the constant swapping of them in Edit -> Preferences
-> Protocols -> TLS -> (deep breath) -> Master-Secret Key file and
not knowing why you didn't pick the right one this time because the
TLS stuff is still encrypted.

Behaviour:
- When a trace gets loaded (or startup), it will load the keys in the files.
- When a trace gets closed (or shutdown), it will unload the keys in memory.
- The addition of the new data is done once "accept" or "apply" is pressed in the Preferences dialog.
- The removal of the current data will happen once the trace is closed.
